title: Analysis reports all validation errors
requirement: Несколько независимых ошибок Analysis Record должны возвращаться одним списком за один вызов, без серии fail-fast раундов и без частичной записи.
reason: Automated by the behavioral proof; the red run below is against the previous committed store bytes.
steps: Call analysis_upsert once with independent defects in decisions, contracts, data ownership and trace references.
Assert one invalid_record response contains findings for decisions[0].decision, contracts[0].change, data[0].ownerComponentId and trace[0].requirementId.
Assert no record file was created and no rev changed.
Run the same proof against a scratch copy with the strict validation call removed and observe red.
expected: All independent errors are returned in a single findings[] response; no partial file and no cascading repeat rounds.
